entities.name: 2-Aminopyridine
observations: Decoded first reactant: Nc1ccccn1; the exocyclic amino nitrogen is the acylated nucleophile.

entities.name: 2-(5-Bromopyridin-2-yl)acetic acid
observations: Decoded second reactant: O=C(O)Cc1ccc(Br)cn1; it is the free carboxylic acid used for amide coupling.

entities.name: N-(Pyridin-2-yl)-2-(5-bromopyridin-2-yl)acetamide
observations: Product assignment: O=C(Cc1ccc(Br)cn1)Nc1ccccn1, formed by acylation of the exocyclic amino group rather than the pyridine ring nitrogen.

entities.name: TBTU-DIPEA-THF amide coupling
observations: Closest exact precedent uses a TBTU-like uronium coupling reagent, DIPEA or Hünig's base, and THF for coupling the free acid with 2-aminopyridine.

entities.name: Amide coupling of bromopyridylacetic acid
observations: Transformation is a carboxylic-acid/amine amide coupling; the new bond joins the acid carbonyl carbon to the exocyclic amino nitrogen of 2-aminopyridine.
